cases.note: The automation moves the ticket that triggered it, and the update fires it again: a deliberate cycle. The @filter holds until's negation, so the write that makes the ticket done is the last one it fires for, and maxDepth bounds the chain whatever happens.
The refusal prints the @filter that would stop the loop: the author's own, and until's negation.

only an event-triggered automation can be in one
